name: Vallée de Mai Nature Reserve
description: Tucked into the island of Praslin in the Seychelles, this small reserve of just 19.5 hectares shelters a primeval palm forest. It is the home of the coco de mer, whose double-lobed nut is the largest seed of any plant on Earth. Walking among its towering fronds, you may also spot the rare Seychelles black parrot.
